name: [R28] IDE/AI-coding extension process creates SSH keys or edits authorized_keys
message:
Exploratory heuristic for the pattern reported around a tampered copy of Anthropic's "Claude Code" extension published to Cursor's VS Code Extension Marketplace (v2.1.312/2.1.313, live ~11 hours on 2026-10-29, up to ~5,000 users affected). The malicious code ran on extension load -- no agent interaction required -- and attempted to plant SSH keys for persistent remote access. Cursor warned uninstalling the extension may not remove already-dropped persistence scripts. No IOC (hash/C2 domain) has been published as of this writing; this is a behavioral proxy for the general technique, not a signature for this specific campaign.

Treat every hit as a lead: remote-development extensions (Remote-SSH, devcontainers) legitimately manage SSH material as part of their normal function -- allowlist known extension IDs before trusting this alone.

cases.name: Editor/extension-host process wrote SSH key material
